tools.name: search_schools
tools.description: Search Hungarian secondary schools (gimnázium, technikum, szakképző) ranked by the share of students passing an advanced-level érettségi exam (official KIR data, last 3 years). Filter by city, county, school type, minimum advanced-level share or name.

tools.name: get_school
tools.description: Full official data for one secondary school by its id (OM azonosító, optionally -site): yearly érettségi results, admissions (first-choice applicants per place), national competency assessment scores vs national and same-type averages.

tools.name: compare_schools
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2–5 secondary schools by id.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Hungarian towns with secondary schools and school counts.
